verdict.rationale: Docs give core counts (16-core CPU, 40-core GPU) and general performance claims (Xcode build/simulator speed, ML workloads), and community evidence includes an independent Geekbench multi-core comparison showing it beating a 13900K, but there's no documented boost-clock behavior and the Geekbench comparison is questioned generically for verification reliability rather than concretely refuted. missing for 10: explicit boost/clock behavior, dedicated compiler/build benchmark corroboration (e.g., real-world codebase compile times), and stronger independent validation beyond a single HN Geekbench link.
